worktree.setup:
set -eu
: "${PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH:?Paseo source checkout path is required}"
umask 077
if [ -L .aws ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Refusing a symlink at workspace .aws.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p .aws
chmod 700 .aws
if [ -L .aws/.gitignore ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Refusing a symlink at .aws/.gitignore.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$(tail -n 1 .aws/.gitignore 2>/dev/null || true)" != '*' ]; then
  printf '\n*\n' >> .aws/.gitignore
fi
for name in aleckim.pem credentials; do
  target=".aws/$name"
  source="$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.aws/$name"
  if [ -e "$target" ] || [ -L "$target" ]; then
    printf 'Keeping existing %s.\n' "$target"
  elif [ -f "$source" ]; then
    case "$name" in
      aleckim.pem) mode=400 ;;
      credentials) mode=600 ;;
    esac
    install -m "$mode" "$source" "$target"
    printf 'Copied %s from source checkout.\n' "$target"
  else
    printf 'Source .aws/%s is unavailable; skipping.\n' "$name" >&2
  fi
done
